steps.code:
# Parse each note to extract date and practiced_good_posture status
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

records = []
for note in notes:
    title = note['title']
    # Extract date from title like "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    date_str = title.split(' for ')[1]
    date = datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    content = note['content']
    # Find the line for practiced_good_posture
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
            value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            records.append((date, value == 'yes'))
            break

# Sort by date
records.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

# Compute longest consecutive streak of yes
max_streak = 0
current_streak = 0
prev_date = None
for date, is_yes in records:
    if is_yes:
        if prev_date is not None and (date - prev_date).days == 1:
            current_streak += 1
        else:
            current_streak = 1
        max_streak = max(max_streak, current_streak)
    else:
        current_streak = 0
    prev_date = date

print("Longest practiced-good-posture streak (days):", max_streak)
